name: V1: Turbo Track
summary:
V1: Turbo Track is the future of VR racing, under the VYUG Playspace. It's the first-ever VR car game, where you get to sit behind the wheels of the high-performance vehicles - sleek sports cars to roaring muscle cars. Get ready to feel that rush of adrenaline in a completely immersive 360-degree world.
